A dramatic scene of the fiery furnace. On the outside left, King Nebuchadnezzar looks on in shock from a safe distance. Inside the roaring orange and yellow flames of the large brick furnace, four figures are seen walking calmly. Three are dressed in ancient Middle Eastern tunics, and the fourth figure glows brightly.

A cross-section view of a rocky underground den. In the centre, Daniel is sitting peacefully on a stone, hands clasped in prayer, with a beam of soft light shining down on him from the opening above. Several large male and female lions are lying down around him, looking docile, with their mouths closed.
